blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard on Friday warned that debris from China’s Long March 8A rocket may fall within Philippine waters. In an advisory, the Coast Guard District (CGD) – Palawan advised all mariners, fishing vessels, passenger and cargo vessels to steer clear or exercise caution when traveling within the drop zones on Sunday, Oct. 25. The Philippine Space Agency confirmed that China is scheduled to launch its rocket from Wenchang, Hainan, China between 9:42 a.m. and 10:34 a.m. (Philippine standard time).
